Cecilia Cheung Posted 58 Instagram Stories In One Day — Is That Oversharing? Or "Is She Lonely", Ask Netizens

Fans say she's simply “making full use of the platform”, though others wondered why she suddenly had so much to share.
Jiamun Koh
23 Aug 2026 at 18:00
Share Bookmark Bookmark
Share on Facebook Share on WhatsApp Share on Twitter Share on WeChat

0:00 / 1:43
Instaread

Some say that when someone suddenly becomes unusually active online, it could mean they have something on their mind.

So what, if anything, was behind Cecilia Cheung's sudden Instagram spree?

Advertisement

On Wednesday (Aug 19), netizens noticed that the 46-year-old actress was unusually active on the platform, posting a whopping 58 Instagram Stories in a single day.

Cecilia documented pretty much everything — from getting ready to go out and showing off cute figurines she'd bought at Disneyland to water sports, frying eggs, selfies and other snippets of daily life.

Among the posts was a repost of a cryptic quote that read: “Love doesn't need to be perfect. It has to be loyal and true.”

Her sudden burst of activity quickly got people talking.

Many fans loved how much Cecilia was sharing, praising her for being open and “down-to-earth”.

Advertisement

“Ceci never treats us like outsiders,” gushed one fan.

Another joked: “She posted more Stories today than the number of messages I send in a whole day.”

One fan said Cecilia was simply “making full use of the platform” and “treating Stories like Stories are meant to be used.”

Others, however, wondered if there was more behind the sudden oversharing.

“Is she lonely?” asked one.

Advertisement

Another speculated: “She must have something on her mind.”

Cecilia shares two sons — Lucas, 19, and Quintus, 16 — with ex-husband Nicholas Tse. The former couple divorced in 2011. She also has a seven-year-old son, Marcus, whose father's identity has not been publicly disclosed.

Then again, maybe Cecilia just had a really happening day and wanted everyone to know about it.
